description: 2 tactical challenges for Black in the MacCutcheon Variation. Play 4...Bb4! and provoke weaknesses.

drills.briefExplanation: 4...Bb4! 5.e5 h6 6.Bh4 g5! — pin, kick, and gain space with tempo.
drills.description: Black to play. White pins with 4.Bg5 — answer with the MacCutcheon 4...Bb4!.
drills.explanation: The MacCutcheon Variation: Black meets 4.Bg5 with the provocative 4...Bb4!, pinning the c3 knight. After 5.e5 h6 White must decide — the bishop retreats, and Black will follow with ...g5 and ...Ne4, gaining space and time. The pin forces White to show their hand; Black's counterplay comes fast.
drills.name: The Bb4 Provocation

drills.briefExplanation: 6...g5 7.Bg3 Ne4 8.f3 Nxc3 — space with tempo, outpost, then remove the defender.
drills.description: Black to play. White retreated 6.Bh4 — push 6...g5! and follow with 7...Ne4.
drills.explanation: The MacCutcheon in full flow: after 5.e5 h6 6.Bh4, Black plays 6...g5! — gaining space with tempo. After 7.Bg3 Ne4 8.f3 Black takes the defender with 8...Nxc3!, and after 9.bxc3 White's queenside is shattered. The knight did its job before being traded.
drills.name: The g5 Push

name: MacCutcheon Variation — Black Tactics
